transcript.text: Thanks for calling Summit Air, you've reached our automated assistant. How can I help?
Hi, I just turned on my heat for the first time this year and there was a dusty burning smell. Could someone come check my furnace?
That dusty smell on first heat use is normal. Can you please tell me the ZIP code and what kind of home it is?
Sure, my ZIP code is 11801, and it's a house.
We can send a technician tomorrow. They can arrive between 8 and 10 in the morning, or between 10 and noon, or between noon and 2 in the afternoon. Which window would work best for you?
The 8 to 10 in the morning window works for me, please.
Great, I'll get that slot ready for you. Can I have your first and last name, please?
Thanks, Ana. What is the best phone number to reach you at?
Got it, 5-1-6, 5-5-5, 0-1-7-7. Please confirm, is that right?
And the service address is a house in ZIP code 11801, correct? May I have the full address, please?
Yes, that’s right. The address is 4 Birch Lane, Hicksville, NY 11801.
Thank you, 4 Birch Lane, Hicksville, NY, 11801. Is that correct?

You're all set for tomorrow, Wednesday, between 8 and 10 in the morning, at 4 Birch Lane, Hicksville. A technician will come then to check the dusty burning smell from your first heat use. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that’s all for now. Thanks so much! Goodbye.
You're welcome, Ana. Have a good day and goodbye.

tone.name: tone
tone.detail: The conversation was warm, clear, brief, asked for one thing at a time without repetition or jargon, and did not invent facts or promises.
